label: Cost per unit along paths
subgoals: Attach a per-unit cost to each arc
Find the cheapest s-t path for one unit
Multiply flow by cost on each arc and sum

label: Successive shortest paths
subgoals: Find the cheapest path in the residual graph
Push the bottleneck amount along it
Repeat until the demand is met, using backward arcs at negative cost

label: Legalization as a transportation problem
subgoals: Model overfull bins as supplies and free room as demands
Cost each move by its distance
Solve the transportation problem as a min-cost flow
